### Featured projects

- **[EEG spectral and coherence analysis](https://github.com/furqazaheervi6/EEG-Quantitative-Statistical-Analysis)** (Built-unpublished). Exploratory Python script: epoching, FFT, power spectral density, cross-spectrum, coherence, phase shift. Runs on a simulated signal; not validated on recorded headset data.
- **[NVIDIA Video-to-Data challenge, Track 1 baseline](https://github.com/furqazaheervi6/v2d-challenge)** (Built-unpublished). Reproducible setup plus a deterministic generator that produced a format-valid Track 1 submission scored on all five metrics. A placeholder baseline, not a reconstruction method.
